Which one should you pick?

If you're always on the move and want the best screen-to-battery balance, the Aero 14 is the safest pick — just accept the soldered RAM and glossy panel. If your work means editing video, 3D renders or gaming, the Forge 16 justifies its weight, fan noise and $1,899 price with unmatched performance and upgradeability. On a tighter budget — students and office work especially — the Nimbus 13 delivers the lightest body and longest battery for $999; only plan for an external drive if 256 GB feels tight.
